name: Lifeguard jobs at Goodman Pool (with paid certification class)
what_you_do: Lifeguards watch swimmers at the city's Goodman Pool. The city pays for the lifeguard certification class once you are hired.
who_can_apply: You must be 15 on or before the last day of the training class. You apply and get hired before you attend the class.
pay_detail: Lifeguards start at $18.75 an hour. Head lifeguards start at $20.52.
duration: Summer pool season; paid certification class in spring
deadline_text: Jobs are usually posted in January and stay open until filled. 2026 certification classes were April 4 to 6, May 8 to 10 and May 29 to 31.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the City of Madison job listings. Go to the Job Descriptions and Apply Online section of the page. Look under the Parks Division.
notes: The page says the pool reopens in June 2027, which does not match its 2026 class dates, so confirm timing with Madison Parks. Work permit rule for Wisconsin minors not checked.
